pretreatments.description: Ethanolic organosolv pretreatment: The substrate (20 g dry weight) was mixed with organosolv solution (50% or 75% v/v ethanol) containing 1% sulfuric acid catalyst at temperatures of 120, 140, or 180 °C for 60 minutes. The reaction was followed by filtration, washing with ethanol and distilled water, drying, and solute recovery.

Enzymatic hydrolysis: Enzymatic hydrolysis was performed using a mixture of Cellic CTec2 and Cellic HTec2 enzymes (ratio 1:9) at 45 ± 1 °C for 72 hours in 50 mM sodium citrate buffer (pH 4.8), applied to the residual solids.
